evals.prompt: Our checkout endpoint returned a 500 once yesterday. The retry succeeded and it hasn't happened again. Find the root cause.
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 discipline: no hypothesis chains on a single observation; instrument or find trigger
expectations: Did not proceed past reproduction (Phase 0) on a single observation
Attempted to find a trigger or proposed instrumentation (failing test, probe logging, assertions) so the next recurrence is diagnosable
Used epistemic prefixes like [hypothesis] and [evidence: X] when reporting claims
Did not declare the bug transient or fixed without evidence
Did not present a plausible-sounding root cause without demonstration

evals.prompt: This test fails reliably: `test_invoice_total` expects 110.00 but gets 100.00. The stack trace points to billing/totals.py line 42.
evals.expected_output: End-to-end code read, demonstrated root cause, user-approved minimal fix, tests run
expectations: Read the relevant code path end-to-end rather than sampling fragments
Tracked hypotheses explicitly and closed them before moving on
Only declared a root cause once demonstrated (toggling the condition switches the bug on and off)
Asked the user for approval before applying the fix
Ran tests after applying the fix and reported actual results
